MEASURED 2026-09-19 — the redesign is justified by data, not argument

C · train spoof probe on English, test on Indic
Removing 20 language directions does not recover it. The signal is not there to unmask.

A naive glob of outputs/embeddings_* swallows the holdout. Exclude _ho explicitly.
THE THREE SHORTCUTS — each killed by a named mechanism, proved by a named test
S4 pooling + S6 group balance + vocoder ID
S2 Common Voice + S3 uniform noise
proof: score-vs-SNR slope flat on bonafide
Order matters: fix the representation (S4), then the composition (S5), then the objective (S6). Reversed, the first eats the other two.
